title.en: Verbs that change meaning: -ing or to-infinitive
title.es: Verbos que cambian de significado: -ing o to + infinitivo

summary.en: A few verbs can take both patterns, but the **meaning changes**. Roughly, **-ing** looks at an action that has happened or is in progress, and **to + infinitive** looks at an action that comes next or is intended: _I remember locking the door_ (I did it and I recall it) but _Remember to lock the door_ (don't forget). Verbs like _like_, _love_, _hate_ and _prefer_ allow both with only a small change.
summary.es: Con remember, forget, stop, try, regret y go on, cada patrón significa algo distinto: «recuerdo haberlo hecho» (-ing) frente a «recuerda hacerlo» (to). Con like y prefer la diferencia es mucho menor.

form: **remember/forget + -ing**: a memory of the past; **+ to-infinitive**: an obligation or task
**stop + -ing**: finish an activity; **stop + to-infinitive**: stop in order to do something
**regret + -ing**: be sorry about the past; **regret + to-infinitive**: formal bad news (_I regret to inform you…_)
**go on + -ing**: continue; **go on + to-infinitive**: do the next thing
**like/love/hate/prefer** + -ing (general enjoyment) or + to-infinitive (habit or choice); **would like/prefer** + to-infinitive

uses.text: **Remember and forget**: _I'll never forget **meeting** her_ (a memory). _Don't forget **to book** the tickets._
**Stop**: _He stopped **smoking** last year._ _We stopped **to take** photos._

note.en: In the second sentence, to take is a purpose, not the object of stop.
note.es: Aquí to take expresa finalidad: «paramos para hacer fotos».

uses.text: **Try**: _Try **turning** it off and on again_ (an experiment). _I tried **to open** the door, but it was stuck._
**Regret**: _I regret **telling** him the secret._ _We regret **to announce** that the flight is cancelled._
**Go on**: _She went on **talking** for an hour._ _After the introduction, he went on **to explain** the plan._
**Like and prefer**: _I like **cycling**._ _I like **to check** my emails before breakfast._ _I'd prefer **to stay** in tonight._

mistakes.wrong: I stopped to smoke last year.

why.en: To smoke would mean you stopped (walking, working…) in order to smoke.
why.es: I stopped to smoke significa «paré para fumar», no «dejé de fumar».

mistakes.wrong: Remember to see that film; it was brilliant.
mistakes.right: I remember seeing that film; it was brilliant.

why.en: A memory of a past action takes the -ing form.
why.es: Para un recuerdo del pasado usa remember + -ing.

mistakes.wrong: I forgot posting the letter, so it's still on my desk.
mistakes.right: I forgot to post the letter, so it's still on my desk.

why.en: If you did not do something because it slipped your mind, use forget + to-infinitive. Forget + -ing is about memories of things you did, mostly in I'll never forget…
why.es: No lo hiciste porque se te olvidó: forget to + infinitivo. Forget + -ing es recordar algo que sí hiciste (I'll never forget…).

mistakes.wrong: I would like going to the cinema tonight.
mistakes.right: I would like to go to the cinema tonight.

why.en: Would like / would prefer are followed by the to-infinitive.
why.es: Con would like va to + infinitivo.

examples.en: I remember handing in the form, so it must be in the system.
examples.es: Recuerdo haber entregado el formulario, así que debe de estar en el sistema.

examples.en: Please remember to switch off the lights when you leave.
examples.es: Por favor, acuérdate de apagar las luces al salir.

examples.en: We stopped to ask for directions at a petrol station.
examples.es: Paramos a preguntar el camino en una gasolinera.

examples.en: If the Wi-Fi is slow, try moving closer to the router.
I tried to call you, but your phone was off.
She regrets not studying harder at school.
We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.
He went on speaking, even though nobody was listening.
After graduating, she went on to become a surgeon.
I'd rather walk, but I prefer to take the bus when it rains.

practice.prompt: I'll never forget ___ the sea for the first time.

explanation.en: A memory of a past experience takes forget + -ing.

practice.prompt: I was tired, so I stopped ___ a coffee.

explanation.en: Stopped in order to have a coffee: the to-infinitive shows purpose.

practice.prompt: The printer isn't working. Try ___ it off and on.

explanation.en: Try + -ing means experiment with a possible solution.

practice.prompt: We regret ___ you that the event has been postponed.

explanation.en: Regret + to-infinitive is the formal way of announcing bad news.
